questions.text: Who is the intended user of the Comprehension Checkpoint this spec describes?
options: The developer who just finished writing or reviewing a feature spec
End users of the software being specified
questions.expected_answer: The developer who just finished writing/reviewing a feature spec.md (whether they wrote it themselves or an AI drafted it from their description), per User Story 1.
questions.source_heading: User Story 1 - Take the comprehension checkpoint on a finished spec (Priority: P1)

questions.text: Does the checkpoint need explicit approval before applying a spec repair?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. The developer's explicit approval is required.
questions.source_heading: User Story 3 - The checkpoint never tests information the spec doesn't establish (Priority: P2); FR-003

questions.text: A developer answers with an implementation detail instead of spec-level content. Is that answer in scope for the checkpoint?
questions.expected_answer: No. Implementation details are out of scope for this checkpoint.

questions.text: After a developer answers incorrectly, does the checkpoint advance to the next level?
questions.expected_answer: No. It stays at the current level until the developer demonstrates understanding or skips.

questions.text: Does the spec allow checkpoint answers to be written to repository files?
questions.expected_answer: No. Checkpoint answers are never written to repository files.
